window-1.title: Artcontext
window-1.blurb: It's one artist's decades-deep warren of collaborative browser drawing tools and net experiments, and you can actually leave your own marks inside it — old-web, zero polish, exactly your kind of rabbit hole.

window-2.title: Announcing the 2026 LensCulture Art Photography Award Winners
window-2.blurb: A fresh dump of photographers nobody's told you about yet — staged worlds, strange grain, invented selves — basically a scroll designed to give you your next shoot idea before you finish it.

window-3.title: Cucumber Basil & Citrus Mocktail
window-3.blurb: You make your own basil syrup and pack the glass with hand-cut cucumber matchsticks — it's less a drink than a tiny green installation, and exactly the kind of fussy-on-purpose hosting move you'd commit to fully.

window-4.title: Earthy, Layered Interiors in a Notting Hill Apartment
window-4.blurb: This one's a masterclass in making a room feel warm through texture alone — clay tones, worn textiles, soft pools of lamplight — and I think it'd be a dream reference for that lived-in corner you keep almost building.
